propositions: Core CLI execution must route through a single validated lazy handler selected from the registry after the pre-operation help boundary, eliminating parallel selection authorities.
Only the selected handler and parser modules are imported per command invocation; unrelated optional stack and handler factories remain unloaded.

Registry-derived mount eligibility, initialization policy (none/init_only/full), and conditional selectors must match the pre-cutover census for all 27 routes including no-auto-mount and conditional cases.
The router preserves the original command remainder argv unchanged and the selected S2 factory parses it exactly once; no route-level option grammar or second parse occurs.
Confirmation context, global output extraction, legacy JSON shapes, token preservation after --, streams, exit codes, and exception propagation must match existing behavioral contracts.
Bridge compatibility spellings and hidden bridge-status must execute through approved adapters while purge-bridge remains unknown.
